Class DataStore

java.lang.Object
library.storage.DataStore
public class DataStore extends Object
File-based persistence for the library. Users, books, members, loans and transactions are saved as simple CSV files inside a data folder (by default data/) using only java.nio. Fields containing commas or quotes are quoted CSV-style. Corrupt lines are skipped instead of crashing the application.
Author:
Usman
